args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like that it's clean and simple, and it's great that you've included your contact email so people can easily reach you. That said, the site is quite minimal at the moment — you might consider adding a bit more about yourself, such as your background, interests, or projects you're working on. Some visuals or a short bio could really help visitors get to know you better. Overall, a nice start — keep building on it!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives your blog a personal and authentic touch. It would be wonderful to see more content about your hiking adventures, like trail recommendations, photos from your trips, or tips for fellow hikers. Adding a few more details about yourself and your other interests could also make the blog feel more complete. Keep up the great work — I look forward to reading more!
